goal: Add exact evidence navigation, read-only linear graph projections and persisted saved filter definitions without mutating source canvas geometry or content.
non_goals: Do not implement Task 18 export removal, Task 19 credential migration or Task 20 recovery.
Do not copy node bodies into saved views or change source node positions.
Do not make low-confidence evidence auto-navigate without candidate confirmation.
Do not merge AI-derived relations into CanvasDocument manual edges.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence navigation stores the origin viewport, focuses exact node/range anchors, supports previous/next and returns to the origin viewport.
Low-confidence results show candidates before navigation while accepted evidence collapses the answer HUD and may switch source canvas explicitly.
Linear projections traverse one/two hops across selected manual and AI relations with deterministic time/relevance/distance/manual ordering.
Saved views persist only filter/sort/relation-source definitions and recompute current references on reopen.
Navigation and linear browsing never copy node bodies, write source positions or create manual history entries.
Focused tests, Canvas regression, TypeScript, production build, independent review and exhaustive L2 impact pass.
notes: Use test-first implementation and keep ordinary audit reporting concise.
Evidence focus uses anchor node/range references and state outside CanvasDocument.
Saved filters store definitions only; reopening recomputes against current data.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for Chinese UI copy and non-ASCII source.
